2014_subclasses.way-of-the-long-death.de: Monks of the Way of the Long Death obsess over the meaning and mechanics of dying. They study creatures as they die and record the exact moment when the soul leaves the body.
2014_subclasses.way-of-the-long-death.to: Gain temporary hit points equal to Wisdom modifier + monk level when reducing a creature within 5 ft to 0 HP.

Your study of death allows you to extract vitality from dying creatures. When you reduce a creature within 5 feet of you to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier + your monk level (minimum 1).
2014_subclasses.way-of-the-long-death.ho: Frighten all creatures within 30 feet that can see you on a failed Wisdom saving throw.

As an action, you unleash the macabre presence of death. Each creature within 30 feet of you that can see you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you until the end of your next turn.
2014_subclasses.way-of-the-long-death.ma: Spend 1 ki point when reduced to 0 hit points to drop to 1 hit point instead.
Beginning at 11th level, you use your familiarity with death to escape its grasp. When you are reduced to 0 hit points, you can expend 1 ki point (no action required) to have 1 hit point instead.
2014_subclasses.way-of-the-long-death.to: Spend 1 to 10 ki points on a touched creature to deal 2d10 necrotic damage per ki point spent.

Your touch channels the pure energy of death. As an action, you touch one creature within 5 feet of you and expend 1 to 10 ki points. The target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d10 necrotic damage per ki point spent on a failure, or half as much on a success.
